questions.q: A seed bank has found incorrect labels in two boxes. Four more boxes are awaiting inspection; no results for them are available. What can be concluded now?
o: The other boxes may contain errors, but this is unconfirmed.
All six boxes have already been shown to carry wrong labels.
Every uninspected box must be free from labelling mistakes.
The first two findings prove that the inspectors were biased.

exp.trans: 种子库已发现两个盒子的标签有误，另外四个仍在等检查，尚无结果。其他盒子可能有误，但不能说已确认。
exp.structure: has found限定已知发现的范围为two boxes；Four more boxes是are awaiting的主语，待检查状态与no results共同标出证据边界。
exp.other: seed bank种子库；label标签；inspection检查；biased有偏见的。
exp.meaning: 已检查对象的结果不能自动外推给未检查对象。may保留可能性；already shown、must及prove都需要更强证据。
exp.rest: “六个都已证实标签错误”扩大已知范围；“未检查者必定无误”把未知反向说成确定；“发现错误证明检查者偏见”凭空增加了因果和动机判断。

questions.skill: 识别with复合结构的伴随状态
questions.q: The archive reopened at noon, with several boxes waiting in the loading area. What does the with-clause do?
o: It describes a state accompanying the archive's reopening.
It gives the sole reason the archive reopened at noon.
It reports an action that archive staff carried out.
It is the direct object of reopened in the main clause.

exp.trans: 档案馆中午重新开放，当时有几个箱子正等在装卸区。with结构补充了重新开放时伴随的状态。
exp.structure: 主干是The archive reopened at noon；with several boxes waiting in the loading area是with + 名词 + 现在分词结构，several boxes是waiting的逻辑主语。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；reopen 重新开放；loading area 装卸区；accompany 伴随。
exp.meaning: with复合结构常补充主句发生时的伴随状态。它不是reopened的直接宾语，也不自动表达原因或目的。
exp.rest: 句子没有说明这是档案馆重新开放的唯一原因；with短语描述箱子所处的状态，并未说工作人员另做了一项动作；reopened在这里是不及物动词，不需要直接宾语。

questions.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
questions.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

questions.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 攀爬
固守
批评
修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: 攀爬对应climb，不是cling to规则的比喻；批评和修改是对规则采取改变的态度，语境却说仍不愿放弃旧规则。

questions.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
questions.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
questions.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

questions.target: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

questions.target: ever vs even / 曾经与甚至
questions.q: Have you ______ attended a blind-review workshop? Surprisingly, the university ______ invited first-year students to participate. Choose the best pair.
o: even / ever
then / even
ever / even
ever / then

exp.trans: 你曾经参加过匿名评审工作坊吗？令人意外的是，学校甚至邀请大一学生参与。
exp.structure: Have you ... attended是现在完成时疑问句；ever修饰attended；Surprisingly在后句提供意外语气，even修饰invited强调连大一学生也被邀请。
exp.other: blind review 匿名评审；workshop 工作坊；first-year student 大一学生；participate 参与。
exp.meaning: ever表示曾经/在任何时候，与现在完成时常见；even表示甚至/连……也，强调程度或意外，两者不可互换。
exp.rest: 把even放在曾经参加的时间提问位置、把ever放在甚至邀请的位置，均改变原意；then只表示随后，不能表达意外程度。

questions.target: 事实描述 / 作者价值判断
questions.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
questions.q: A report says that residents posted hundreds of angry comments after the council announced a parking plan. Which conclusion is directly supported?
o: The report endorses the angry comments as a fair response.
Residents posted many angry comments after the announcement.
The council designed the plan knowing it would harm residents.
The comments show that opposition extended to every resident.

exp.trans: 一份报告说，市议会公布停车方案后，居民发布了数百条愤怒评论。原文直接支持：居民在公告后发布了大量愤怒评论；after只说明先后，不能据此确定因果。
exp.structure: 主句：A report（主语）+ says（谓语）+ that宾语从句。that从句：residents（主语）+ posted（谓语）+ hundreds of angry comments（宾语）；after从句只交代时间。句子报告发生了什么，没有评价这些评论是否应得。
exp.other: council 市议会；announce 公布；substantial 大量的/显著的；reaction 反应。
exp.meaning: 负面评论的存在不等于作者认为批评对象活该。after只报告时间先后；要断言公告引发评论，还需要明确的因果证据。
exp.rest: 报告评论数量不等于赞同评论；设计有害方案的动机没有证据；数百条评论不能扩大为每一位居民的立场。

inference-boundary.target: 重新审视惯例 vs 无依据的未来结果
inference-boundary.skill: 推断必须有直接语义支撑
inference-boundary.q: An architect argues: 'When an old street layout fails its users, we should question the layout instead of assuming that pedestrians are the problem.' Later the article mentions plans to renovate the district. Which view is most directly supported by the architect's remark?
o: Old designs should be reconsidered when experience reveals their limits.
Every renovation will inspire a generation of future architects.
Pedestrian choices have no effect on city traffic.
New designs should always replace old ones, even when they work.

exp.trans: 建筑师认为，旧道路布局若不能服务使用者，就应质疑布局本身，而不是预设行人有问题。引文支持反思既有设计，而非预言未来创新的效果。
exp.structure: When从句给出条件；we should question A instead of assuming B是核心主张。Later句子另行交代翻修计划，但没有为引文添加未来代际因果关系。
exp.other: layout 布局；pedestrian 行人；renovate 翻修；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 引用某人的一句话，优先提炼这句话本身可支持的思考方式。与文章主题有关的后续结果可能合理，但若引文没谈到，就不能据此归给说话人。
exp.rest: 鼓舞未来建筑师引入未提及的影响链；完全否认行人作用和一律淘汰旧设计，都比原话更绝对。

inference-boundary.target: 思考方式 vs 后代研究因果
inference-boundary.q: A historian says of a newly revised account: 'The documents did not change; the questions I asked of them did.' The article later notes that her book was reprinted thirty years later. What does her statement most strongly suggest?
o: An influential book must be reprinted before its argument becomes valid.
Repeatedly publishing the same documents automatically produces new discoveries.
Revisiting familiar evidence with different questions can yield new interpretations.
The historian's method necessarily shaped every later generation of researchers.

exp.trans: 历史学家说：文献没有改变，改变的是我向它们提出的问题。这表明熟悉的证据也能因为新的提问方式产生新解释。
exp.structure: The documents did not change与the questions ... did形成对照；did代替did change，省略重复的动词原形change。后句reprinted thirty years later说的是再版事实，不包含对后代研究的必然影响。
exp.other: historian 历史学家；document 文献；reprint 再版；interpretation 解释。
exp.meaning: ‘旧材料+新问题→新解释’是引文直接支持的内容。后面提及多年后再版，并不能证明她影响了所有后来研究，更不能把时间先后直接改成因果。
exp.rest: 把再版当成论证有效性的必要条件属于添加规则；自动产生发现与提问改变的机制不符；对所有后代研究产生必然影响远超引文证据。

inference-boundary.skill: 行动证据与态度变化证据
inference-boundary.q: A tenants' group rallied 800 long-time supporters at a public hearing against a proposed rent increase. No survey of participants' earlier opinions was conducted. Which statement is warranted?
o: It converted former opponents into supporters of the group.
It mobilized supporters; a change of views is unproved.
It persuaded the city to cancel the proposed rent increase.
Most residents have shifted from support to opposition.

exp.trans: 租户组织动员了800名长期支持者，在公开听证会上反对拟议涨租。没有调查这些参与者以前的观点。只能确认组织动员了支持者，不能确认他们是被说服后改变立场。
exp.structure: A tenants' group + rallied + long-time supporters；No survey ... was conducted明确缺失了对以前态度的测量。Which statement is warranted要求只说证据足以支持的内容。
exp.other: tenant 租户；rally 动员；hearing 听证会；prior attitude 先前态度。
exp.meaning: rally supporters是组织已有支持者采取行动；change someone's political attitude要有前后立场变化的证据。动员和说服是不同关系。
exp.rest: 原文称参加者为长期支持者，没有原先反对的证据；未报告提案撤销；800名参与者也不能代表多数居民的态度转变。

inference-boundary.target: 态度确有变化 vs 是否由活动造成
inference-boundary.q: After a public campaign, a survey of the same 500 residents found support for the new bus plan had risen from 30% to 55%. During the same period, a fare cut was also announced. What is the most defensible conclusion?
o: The campaign explains the full rise in support for the plan.
Support rose; the campaign's separate effect remains unclear.
Residents' attitudes stayed the same despite the campaign.
The fare cut explains the full rise in support for the plan.

exp.trans: 一场宣传活动之后，对同一批500名居民的调查发现，新公交方案支持率从30%升至55%；与此同时还宣布降低车费。能确定支持率发生变化，但不能断定全由宣传活动造成。
exp.structure: a survey ... found + that支持率变化；During the same period引入另一同时发生的因素，阻止将全部变化归因于campaign。
exp.other: fare cut 降低票价；resident 居民；causal effect 因果效应；establish 证实。
exp.meaning: 这次确有前后态度数据，因此不能机械否认变化；但‘变化发生了’与‘某活动单独导致变化’仍是两回事。推断题要守住证据提供的层级。
exp.rest: 同群体前后调查证明支持率上升，但同期还有票价变化，不能把全部变化单独归给宣传或降价；态度未变则与调查结果冲突。

inference-boundary.q: An arts fund pays travel expenses for at most three performers in each selected troupe. The rest of the troupe may still take part at its own expense. Which inference is warranted?
o: Every funded troupe must contain at most three performers.
A troupe with four performers cannot enter the festival.
Only three performers from a troupe are allowed onstage.
The payment limit does not cap the size of a troupe.

exp.trans: 艺术基金为每个入选剧团最多三名演员支付差旅费，其余演员仍可自费参与。因此获资助人数的限制不等于剧团人数的上限。
exp.structure: at most three performers限定基金付费覆盖的人；第二句The rest仍可参与，明确区分资助范围与参与范围。
exp.other: troupe 剧团；travel expense 差旅费；at its own expense 自费；cap 限制上限。
exp.meaning: 数字出现后应先问“限制的是谁的什么权利”。对报销人数的限制不能移成对团队人数、报名资格或上台人数的限制。
exp.rest: “每团最多三人”“四人剧团不能参加”“仅三人可上台”都把差旅资助范围扩大成团队规模或参与资格限制，且忽略其余演员可自费参与。

inference-boundary.q: The director insists on formal titles and a clear chain of command. This explains why her staff describe her as hierarchical. Which conclusion is supported?
o: She values distinctions of rank within the workplace.
She takes a tough line in every wage negotiation.
She prevents junior staff from expressing any opinion.
She supports the same political party as her managers.

exp.trans: 主管要求使用正式职衔并保持明确的指挥层级，因此员工说她等级观念强。能确定的是她重视工作场所的等级区分。
exp.structure: The director是主语，insists on连接她强调的组织安排；This回指前句行为；describe her as hierarchical是员工对这种行为特征的概括。
exp.other: hierarchical 等级分明的、等级观念强的；chain of command 指挥链；take a tough line on 对某事采取强硬立场。
exp.meaning: 组织等级观念与具体议题上的立场强硬是不同判断。要把评价落实到原文给出的行为维度，不能因为某个形容词听起来强势就添加其他政治或谈判结论。
exp.rest: 谈判一概强硬、禁止下属发表任何意见、与经理支持同一政党都增加了原文没有提供的具体立场或限制。

inference-boundary.target: 情态强度 / 改选证据
inference-boundary.skill: 比较初选与改选的证据支持
inference-boundary.q: A memo says, "The council may consider giving street musicians a few extra evening slots." A reader first chooses "Extra slots are a possibility", then changes to "The council is now cutting performance time". No other evidence is given. Which judgment is warranted?
o: The revision fits because all new policies cut time.
The initial reading fits the proposal's uncertainty.
The revision fits because consider means implement.
The initial reading proves extra slots are certain.

exp.trans: 备忘录说，市议会可能考虑多给街头音乐家一些晚间时段。读者先理解为可能增加时段，后改为议会现在正削减演出时间。在没有其他证据时，初选与原句相符。
exp.structure: The council是主语，may consider是谓语，giving...是consider的宾语；giving结构中street musicians是接受者，a few extra evening slots是给予的内容。may同时保留考虑及执行上的不确定性；is now cutting则声称削减正在发生。
exp.other: memo备忘录；council市议会；slot时段；warranted有依据的。
exp.meaning: 改选必须有更强且相关的文本证据。这里extra表示增加，may consider不等于已经执行；改选同时改变了方向与确定性。结论来自证据匹配，不能归纳为一律坚持初选。
exp.rest: “新政策都削减时间”是无依据概括；“consider等于implement”混淆考虑与实施；“必定增加”也把可能性夸大成确定性。只有承认初选符合提议的不确定性才保留了原句边界。

inference-boundary.q: A music academy has confirmed two scholarship awards. Three other applicants still await an audition, and no decisions on them have been announced. Which inference is warranted?
o: All five applicants have already been given awards.
Every pending applicant will be refused an award.
Further awards are possible, but not yet confirmed.
The two confirmed awards have now been withdrawn.

exp.trans: 音乐学院已确认两份奖学金，另外三名申请者仍在等试演，尚无决定公布。因此，可能还有人获奖，但目前不能确认结果。
exp.structure: has confirmed表明已有结果；other applicants与still await把另一组人放在尚待处理阶段；no decisions...进一步排除对他们已有定论的说法。
exp.other: academy学院；scholarship奖学金；audition试演；pending待处理的。
exp.meaning: 等待某程序只说明状态，既不等于已获肯定结果，也不等于将获否定结果。可以保留可能性，不能把它升级为确定事实。
exp.rest: “五人全已获奖”把待试演者混入已确认者；“待处理者全会被拒”把未知变成必然；“原两份已撤回”增加了不存在的逆转。

with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

with.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
with.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

cling-climb.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

causal-role-direction.target: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.skill: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.q: By accepting a single signed form, the club allows volunteers to avoid requesting a separate signature for every shift. Which benefit is described?
o: Volunteers may work extra shifts without signing any form.
Volunteers need not seek another signature for each shift.
Supervisors supply more signatures for every new volunteer.
Only supervisors may change the shifts a volunteer accepts.

exp.trans: 俱乐部接受一份签好字的表格，从而使志愿者不必每个班次都另外请求签字。好处是省去反复请求签字的手续。
exp.structure: By accepting...说明俱乐部采取的措施；allows的宾语是volunteers；to avoid requesting...说明志愿者由此免于什么行为。separate signature是被省去的逐班次手续。
exp.other: shift 班次；signature 签字；avoid doing 避免做、不必做；single 单份的。
exp.meaning: 使某人免于寻找或请求某物，不等于给他更多该物。先列措施、受益主体、被省去的行为和结果，再检查选项有没有改成增加数量或扩大资格。
exp.rest: 原文仍有一份已签字表格，不能说完全无须签字或允许多工作班次；也未说主管供应更多签字；变更班次的权限没有提及。

subject.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to steam yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。选项中的被动改写为：窗帘昨天受了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 原主干The cleaner + subjected + the curtains + to a steam treatment。被动改写将the curtains作主语，were subjected是一般过去时被动谓语，to steam说明处理内容，yesterday保留时间；施事已经明确时可省略by the cleaner。这里不是系表结构。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: were subjected to steam表示窗帘昨天实际经历了蒸汽处理；关键是事件性的被动谓语，不是可能受影响或适合处理的状态。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

subject.target: be subject to / 实际事件
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: The mountain road is subject to closure during heavy snow. No closure has been announced today. Which report preserves both statements?
o: The road is reported closed after today's heavy snowfall.
Snow may close the road; no closure is reported today.
The road underwent a test involving closure earlier today.
The road is open because snow cannot lead to its closure.

exp.trans: 这条山路在大雪期间可能封闭。今天尚未宣布封路。准确报道是：大雪可能带来封路，但这两句没有报道今天已经封路。
exp.structure: The mountain road是主语，is是系动词，subject to closure表达所受约束或可能状态。第二句No closure是主语，has been announced是现在完成时被动谓语；没有公告不等于已验证现场一定开放。
exp.other: mountain road 山路；closure 封闭；announce 宣布；status 状态。
exp.meaning: be subject to可表示有可能受某变化影响，不自动表示该事件已经发生。这里也不能从“尚无公告”推出现场已确认开放。
exp.rest: 原文只报告可能受封闭影响，没有报告今天已封路；封路测试是虚构事件；未公布封路不等于已确认开放，更不能说大雪不会造成封路。

subject.skill: 避免把可能风险扩大成已经发生的事实
subject.q: A mountain road report says heavy snow can lead to closures, but today's bulletin only forecasts snow. Which conclusion is supported?
o: The road is closed today because heavy snow is forecast.
The forecast identifies a risk, not a confirmed closure today.
The road has remained open through every previous snowstorm.
The report proves that snow will not affect road access today.

exp.trans: 山区道路报告说，大雪可能导致封路，但今天的公告只是在预报降雪。最有根据的结论是：预报指出一种风险，并没有确认今天已经封路。
exp.structure: can lead to closures表达可能结果；today's bulletin only forecasts snow限制了当前已知事实。题干要求判断能得出什么结论，而不是推断可能后果已经发生。
exp.other: forecast 预报；closure 封路；confirmed 已确认的；road access 道路通行。
exp.meaning: 不能把条件性风险升级为已发生事件。可能导致封路，不等于今天已经封路；同样也不能反向断言降雪一定不会影响通行。
exp.rest: 预报降雪不等于已经封路；没有证据说明道路经历过所有以往的雪暴；报告指出风险，并没有证明雪不会影响通行。

cloze-time-adverbs.q: The interviewers first rated each applicant on a five-point scale. The scores were ______ combined with a written test result before the committee made its final decision.
o: ever
then
even
unless

exp.trans: 面试官先用五分制给申请者打分，随后将这些分数与笔试成绩合并，最后由委员会作出决定。
exp.structure: first标出初始步骤；The scores were then combined...是被动结构；before引出后续委员会决策，整个流程有清楚的先后顺序。
exp.other: rate 评分；scale 量表；written test 笔试；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: then表示接着/随后；ever强调在任何时候或曾经；even强调甚至/出乎意料；在中性流程描述中then最精确。
exp.rest: ever不能自然表达流程先后；even无须强调出人意料的递进；unless引导条件从句，不能直接充当这个位置的流程副词。

author-stance.target: 引述立场 / 作者限定评价
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: An association calls volunteers “unreliable.” The author notes that missed visits often follow last-minute roster changes. “Better coordination,” she writes, “would be more useful than another lecture about commitment.” Which view belongs to the author?
o: She accepts the association’s description as an explanation for the missed visits.
She regards missed visits as evidence that volunteers want to leave.
She favours improving coordination over simply blaming commitment.
She considers punctuality irrelevant to the association’s work.

exp.trans: 某协会把志愿者称为“不可靠”。作者指出，缺席往往发生在排班临时变动之后。她写道：“更好的协调，比再说教一遍奉献精神更有用。”作者倾向改善协调，而不是简单归咎于态度。
exp.structure: An association + calls + volunteers + unreliable属于引述他人评价。The author + notes + that从句另给解释线索；would be more useful than是作者自己的比较判断，she writes确定说话者。
exp.other: association 协会；roster 排班表；last-minute 临时的；commitment 投入、责任心。
exp.meaning: 先分清谁在评价，再追踪作者自己的证据和限定比较。这里没有deserve或all，也不能把文章引用的标签直接记到作者名下。
exp.rest: accepts the description把协会标签当作者解释，忽略作者提供的排班因素；want to leave补出离开的动机；punctuality irrelevant把“协调更有用”扩大成准时无关，比较优先级不等于否认准时的重要性。

author-stance.q: An editorial says: "Opening the reading room on Sundays deserves a trial. The report offered to justify it, however, omits staff costs and cannot establish that the plan is affordable." How does the editorial assess the report?
o: It is inadequate as a case for the proposal.
It convincingly establishes the project's value.
It merely lists facts without supporting a view.
It gives a fair account of all financial effects.

exp.trans: 社论认为周日开放阅览室值得试行；但作为论据的报告漏计人力成本，无法证明方案负担得起。对报告的判断是论证不足。
exp.structure: Opening...是首句主语；第二句The report是主语，omits与cannot establish是并列谓语。however把值得尝试的方案与不足以支撑它的报告区分开。
exp.other: editorial 社论；justify 为……提供理由；omit 漏计；affordable 负担得起的。
exp.meaning: 问评价时先确定对象。对方案的局部肯定不能代替对报告证据质量的否定评价。
exp.rest: “有力证明项目价值”与cannot establish相反；报告被用来论证方案，不能说不支持任何观点；漏计人力成本使其并未完整涵盖财务影响。
